name: Metaheuristic-Firefly_Algorithm
description: Firefly Algorithm  to Minimize Functions with Continuous Variables

paragraphs: Firefly Algorithm to Minimize Functions with Continuous Variables. The function returns: 1) An array containing the used value(s) for the target function and the output of the target function f(x). For example, if the function f(x1, x2) is used, then the array would be [x1, x2, f(x1, x2)].
features: swarmsize = The population size. The Default Value is 3.
alpha0 = Step size. The Default Value is 0.2.
beta0 = Update parameter. The Default Value is 1.
gamma = Update parameter. The Default Value is 1.
minvalues = The minimum value that the variable(s) from a list can have. The default value is -5.
